title: Venue locations
description: data/venue-locations.json: where each venue is, by venueKey. Written by refine (lib/VenueLocations.ps1: feed and placeholder entries) and by the weekly locate run (lib/VenueAddress.ps1: the rest); an entry set to manual is never changed by either.

from.description: feed: a source sent it. page: the address on the venue's event page, geocoded. address: the address a source sent, geocoded. lookup: found by a name search (old, never written now). zip: the center of the address's ZIP code. manual: set by hand. none: looked up, not found. placeholder: not one place (events in several towns, or a various- or -area venue).
